failure.message:
assert 4 == (2 + 1) + where 4 = len([{'program_id': 'aiprog_946028e0eb86', 'user_id': 'usr_b6da582cec48', 'request': {'goal': 'hypertrophy', 'split': 'upper_lower', 'days_per_week': 4, 'experience': 'elite', ...}, 'program_text': "# 🔥 COACH HUTCH | ELITE HYPERTROPHY BLOCK
### Upper/Lower | 4 Days | 200lb Athlete

---

## 📅 WEEKLY SPLIT

| Day | Focus | Primary Movement | Volume Target |
|-----|-------|-----------------|---------------|
| Mon | Upper A — Push Heavy | Bench Press | 18–22 sets |
| Tue | Lower A — Quad Dom | Squat | 20–24 sets |
| Thu | Upper B — Pull Heavy | Weighted Pull-Up | 18–22 sets |
| Fri | Lower B — Hip Dom | Deadlift | 16–20 sets |

---

## 💪 PROGRAM DETAIL

### MON — UPPER A (Push Focus)
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | RPE | Rest |
|----------|-------------|-----|------|
| Bench Press | 4 × 6–8 | 8 | 3 min |
| Incline DB Press | 3 × 10–12 | 7.5 | 2 min |
| OHP | 3 × 8–10 | 7.5 | 2 min |
| Cable Lateral Raise | 3 × 15–20 | 7 | 90s |
| Tricep Rope Pushdown | 3 × 12–15 | 7 | 90s |

### TUE — LOWER A (Quad Dominant)
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | RPE | Rest |
|----------|-------------|-----|------|
| Back Squat | 4 × 6–8 | 8 | 3 min |
| Leg Press | 3 × 10–12 | 8 | 2 min |
...8 |

### THU — Push (Volume)
| Exercise | Sets x Reps | RPE |
|----------|-------------|-----|
| Bench (70% 1RM) | 4x6 | 7 |
| DB Incline | 3x10 | 7.5 |
| Dips (weighted) | 3x8 | 7.5 |
| Tricep Pushdown | 3x12 | 6.5 |

### FRI — Pull (Volume)
| Exercise | Sets x Reps | RPE |
|----------|-------------|-----|
| RDL | 4x6 | 7.5 |
| Chest-Supported Row | 4x8 | 7.5 |
| Lat Pulldown | 3x10 | 7 |
| Hammer Curl | 3x12 | 6.5 |

---

## 📈 PROGRESSION SCHEME

- **Heavy days (Mon/Tue/Wed):** Add **5lb** when RPE drops below target. Linear load progression.
- **Volume days (Thu/Fri):** Double-progression — hit **top of rep range** across all sets before adding load.
- **Deload every 4 weeks:** Drop to RPE 6, reduce volume 40%.

---

## 📝 COACH HUTCH NOTES

> **RPE is law.** Stop ego-lifting garbage reps. RPE 9 means ONE rep left — not "kinda hard."
>
> **Squat depth first, always.** Elite means no shortcuts at the bottom.
>
> **Deadlift:** Brace like your life depends on it. Slack out before you pull.
>
> **Recovery is training.** Sleep 8hrs. Eat above maintenance. You're not cutting — you're **building.**

**Now go move some serious weight. 🏋️**', ...}])
